description:
Treat yourself to a restorative sound bath at the Kona Cloud Forest Sanctuary, where the harmonious tones of crystal singing bowls, other vibrational instruments, and the natural soundscape of the ʻōhiʻa lehua forest resonate through you. 

Perfect for both newcomers and sound bath enthusiasts, this experience combines guided meditation with healing vibrations and the ambiance of the cloud forest, supporting deep relaxation and energetic balance. 

Whether you're new to sound baths or seeking to recharge in nature, our sessions are designed to align your mind and body, offering a rejuvenating retreat in a serene, open-air natural setting. Get cozy, lay back and receive!

## Weekly Schedule:
- Crystal Bowl & Gong Sound Bath with Brooke Olenski: Wednesdays and Saturdays
- Crystal Tone Singing Bowl Sound Bath with Pam Neil: Sundays and Mondays


###Private group or individual sound healings are available other days and times upon advanced request - email us directly :)


###Make it a Day Retreat!
Book an unforgettable Cloud Forest Tour with your Sound Bath. We call this the Cloud Forest Cleanse! Combine these experiences at checkout for a discounted price!

# Pam Neil - Sundays & Mondays

Meet Pam! :) (photo #3) Pam Neil is the founder of Aloha Breathwork where she shares the importance of changing how we breathe to assist us in our inner and outer world by providing breathwork classes, coaching and private sessions for reducing stress, anxiety, sleep issues and also for increasing focus and physical and mental performance.

She works with 12 Crystal Singing Bowls she calls her Bowl Mates and enjoys providing Sound Baths in groups and private sessions, in Yoga classes, or on the beach.

She has been living on the Big Island since 2018 and has had a weekly Breath and Bowls Sound Bath since 2020 where she shares breathing meditations and the beautiful crystalline sounds of the bowls - two powerful modalities – for an experience that transcends ordinary healing/breathwork sessions.

Her desire to help facilitate people who are searching for something different to create a more peaceful, balanced, and easy life filled with love and joy, one breath at a time. 

Pam is a Certified Oxygen Advantage® Advanced Instructor, Certified Conscious Breathwork Facilitator, has a Polyvagal-Informed Certificate for Wellness & Performance Coaching, Life Transformed Certified Coach and Sound and Energy Healer.

restrictions:
#Absolute Contraindications (do not proceed without medical clearance):
    •    Sound-induced epilepsy or history of seizures
    •    Severe mental illness (e.g., schizophrenia, untreated bipolar disorder)
    •    Active substance misuse
    •    Acute psychosis or dissociative disorders

#Relative Contraindications / Caution Advised:
    •    Pregnancy (especially first trimester) – use lower frequencies and avoid instruments directly on the body.
    •    Hearing disorders or sensitivity to sound – tinnitus, hyperacusis.
    •    Metal implants, pacemakers, or hearing aids – high-frequency or strong vibrations may affect devices or comfort.
    •    Recent surgery or injury – some tones may aggravate inflammation or healing tissue.
    •    PTSD or trauma history – sudden sounds can trigger flashbacks or anxiety (check in advance).
    •    Autism spectrum disorders – some individuals may find sounds overstimulating.

faqs:
##Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Can I explore the Sanctuary on my own or do I need a guide?
- We offer guided tours only through the Sanctuary and therefore do not allow anyone to explore the Sanctuary on their own. For safety purposes as well as it creates a much better experience when you learn the story of this privately stewarded land from your tour guide!

When are your Sound Baths?
- We offer Sound Baths multiple days of the week. Check our Sound Bath schedule for the most up to date availability.

What do I need to bring for the Sound Bath?
- We provide cushions and blankets. Please feel free to bring your own pillow and blanket as well! We also encourage an eye mask, a journal to reflect on your experience post sound bath journey, crystals, and anything else you’d like to wear to stay warm and comfortable.

When should I arrive for the Sound Bath?
- We ask that you arrive 10 minutes before the Sound Bath begins. The Sound Bath will begin on time, so it’s important that you arrive early so that you are ready to begin at the start time.

Do you have a bathroom?
- Yes, we have a bathroom for use.

Do you have drinking water and food available?
- We do have water, drinks and snacks available for purchase.

Do you sell gift cards?
- Yes! You can purchase a gift card on our website. When you click the “Book Now” button at the top of the page, at the bottom of the experiences listed, you will see the option to purchase a gift card.

Where are you located?
- We are located 15 minutes up the mountain from the Kailua-Kona Airport and 20 minutes from Kailua-Kona town.

Do you offer private Sound Baths, tours or school group experiences?
- Yes we do! A private Sound Bath is perfect for an anniversary, honey moon, celebration or private group experience. 
Call or email us to inquire about what we offer and/or to book a private experience for your school group, organization or private group.
